worldcombat.skill.wish.summary: Marks a patch of open ground with a wish star; after a delay the star falls back onto that spot and restores a share of maximum health to each friendly combatant inside the landing ring. The star exists on its own, so moving away costs the caster the heal, and if no one needs it the wish is wasted.
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.0: Lay a delayed heal down on a safe landing spot
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.1: Share the wish: everyone in the landing ring gets 60 percent of their base heal (not split by headcount)
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.2: Drop the landing spot under an ally so a substitute can catch it
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.0: Mark open ground within %1$s blocks and send the wish star; it lands %2$s later and restores %3$s of maximum health to each friendly combatant inside the landing ring.
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.1: The landing ring has a radius of %1$s blocks. With Sharing on, the caster and each friendly combatant inside the ring receive %2$s of their base healing amount.
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.share: Sharing wish: the caster and allies in the landing ring each receive %1$s of their base healing. Whoever stands in the ring receives it; moving away gives the caster nothing.
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.self: Selfish wish: only the caster is healed, must stand inside the landing ring, and receives the full fraction. No ally is healed.
worldcombat.skill.wish.timing: A ground-targeted move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: each friendly combatant in the landing ring (caster included) receives 60 percent of their base heal. Off: only the caster is healed for the full amount, and must stand in the ring.
worldcombat.skill.wish.preference.ai.hea: The companion sends the wish early when itself or its target is below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher spends a delayed heal at the first wound.
worldcombat.skill.wish.preference.ai.eme: Below this health ratio the companion stops prioritising Wish and leaves the moment to a more direct heal; higher exits the move earlier at low health.
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.payou: At payout the landing ring alone decides who is healed: friendly combatants standing inside it are restored by their own maximum health, and a caster who moved away receives nothing. Anyone already at full health or already down is not healed, and if nobody needs it the wish is wasted.
